section_text: Consumer includes a person who buys goods or hires or avails services for consideration, subject to statutory exclusions.
A complaint may be filed before the District Commission by a consumer, a recognised consumer association, or other persons authorised by the Act, subject to the statutory conditions.
Information relating to the commission of a cognizable offence may be given to an officer in charge of a police station, subject to the procedure stated in the statute.
authority: Officer in charge of a police station

section_text: The High Court or Court of Session may grant direction for bail to a person apprehending arrest, subject to statutory conditions.
authority: High Court or Court of Session

section_text: Giving or taking dowry is punishable as provided by the Act, subject to the provisions and exceptions stated in the statute.
A State Government may make rules for registration of Hindu marriages in the prescribed manner.
